howto.what: Claude 会指导你设置 Firebase 身份验证，包括启用登录方式、配置客户端 SDK 以及编写安全规则。
howto.when: 当你的应用需要用户登录、用户管理或通过身份验证规则保护数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Firebase 实现邮箱密码登录。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through setting up Firebase Authentication, including enabling sign-in methods, configuring client SDKs, and writing security rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.

say_en.text: Help me implement email/password login with Firebase.
say_en.note: Claude will guide enabling email/password auth and client setup.

say_en.text: How do I add Google Sign-In to my Flutter app?

say_en.text: How to use request.auth in Firebase security rules?
